run_get_demos_main: run the get_demos script to generate QA demos from a dataset using RAG and non-RAG strategies
process_batch_with_strategies: process a dataset batch through multiple strategies and select winners via tournament judging
run_tournament_for_best_predictions: run a bracket-style tournament to choose the best predictions across multiple strategies
choose_best_prediction: use a model to judge and select the best prediction from a list of candidates
create_strategy_with_get_strats: create strategy instances from prompt templates for RAG or non-RAG answer generation
